# epsilon-runtime

> Eclipse Epsilon runtime for Maven and OSGi — wraps the Eclipse Epsilon model transformation, validation, and code generation framework for use outside the Eclipse IDE.

Key facts:
- Java 21 (Zulu JDK), built with Maven 3.9.4+ (wrapper included: `./mvnw`)
- Maven multi-module project, 7 modules (3 core, 3 OSGi/Karaf deployment, 1 reporting)
- Eclipse Epsilon 2.8.0 for model transformation (ETL), validation (EVL), code generation (EGL/EGX), and more
- Eclipse EMF 2.17.0 for metamodel-based model handling
- Supports EMF/Ecore, XML/XSD, and Excel model types
- Dual deployment: standalone Maven and Apache Karaf 4.4.7 / OSGi containers
- Fluent builder API via Lombok (`@Builder`) for all execution contexts
- License: Apache 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with architecture diagrams and transformation example

## Modules — Core

- [epsilon-runtime-execution/pom.xml](epsilon-runtime-execution/pom.xml): Core execution engine — ExecutionContext orchestrator, ModelContext abstraction, language-specific contexts (EOL/ETL/EVL/EGL/EGX/ECL/EML/HUTN), URI handlers, model loading
- [epsilon-runtime-utils/pom.xml](epsilon-runtime-utils/pom.xml): Small utilities — UUID v3 generation, MD5 hashing, string abbreviation by vowel removal
- [epsilon-runtime-eol-patch/pom.xml](epsilon-runtime-eol-patch/pom.xml): Patches to Epsilon EOL internals — optimized exception handling and enhanced reflection-based method discovery

## Modules — OSGi Deployment

- [epsilon-runtime-osgi/pom.xml](epsilon-runtime-osgi/pom.xml): BundleURIHandler — read-only EMF URIHandler that resolves resources from OSGi bundles
- [features/src/main/feature/feature.xml](features/src/main/feature/feature.xml): Karaf feature descriptor listing all OSGi bundles for deployment
- [kar/pom.xml](kar/pom.xml): Karaf KAR archive assembly packaging all bundles and features

## Modules — Reporting

- [epsilon-runtime-reports/pom.xml](epsilon-runtime-reports/pom.xml): JaCoCo aggregate code coverage reports across all modules

## Depends on

- [karaf-features](../../packages/karaf-features): Apache Karaf feature descriptors for 20+ third-party libraries

## Used by

- [judo-jql-ide-eclipse](../../eclipse/judo-jql-ide-eclipse): Eclipse plugin for JQL editing with content assist and validation
- [judo-meta-asm](../../models/judo-meta-asm): ASM metamodel — Ecore-based architecture model with builders and validation
- [judo-meta-esm](../../models/judo-meta-esm): ESM metamodel — business entities, operations, access points, and UI structures
- [judo-meta-expression](../../models/judo-meta-expression): Expression metamodel — type-safe numeric, string, temporal, and collection expressions
- [judo-meta-expression-asm](../../models/judo-meta-expression-asm): Bridges Expression metamodel with ASM for symbolic reference resolution
- [judo-meta-expression-esm](../../models/judo-meta-expression-esm): Bridges Expression metamodel with ESM for expression evaluation and validation
- [judo-meta-expression-psm](../../models/judo-meta-expression-psm): Bridges Expression metamodel with PSM for type resolution and measurement support
- [judo-meta-keycloak](../../models/judo-meta-keycloak): Keycloak IAM configuration metamodel
- [judo-meta-liquibase](../../models/judo-meta-liquibase): Liquibase database change management metamodel
- [judo-meta-measure](../../models/judo-meta-measure): SI units metamodel — measures, units, and conversion rates
- [judo-meta-openapi](../../models/judo-meta-openapi): OpenAPI 2.0 metamodel with bidirectional JSON/YAML transformation
- [judo-meta-psm](../../models/judo-meta-psm): PSM metamodel — foundational platform-specific data model
- [judo-meta-query](../../models/judo-meta-query): Query metamodel — expression-based RDBMS query generation
- [judo-meta-rdbms](../../models/judo-meta-rdbms): RDBMS schema metamodel with incremental evolution tracking
- [judo-meta-script](../../models/judo-meta-script): Script metamodel — typed scripting language with ASM/ESM adapters
- [judo-meta-ui](../../models/judo-meta-ui): UI metamodel — pages, containers, tables, inputs, and data bindings
- [judo-platform](../../runtime/judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
- [judo-rdbms-schema](../../runtime/judo-rdbms-schema): Incremental database schema migration via RDBMS model comparison
- [judo-runtime-core](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core): Multi-module runtime engine — data access, business logic, REST, and security
- [judo-runtime-core-esm-itest](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core-esm-itest): Integration tests for ESM-to-RDBMS transformation pipeline
- [judo-services](../../runtime/judo-services): OSGi runtime services enabling multiple data models in a single Karaf container
- [judo-tatami](../../runtime/judo-tatami): Model transformation pipeline — ESM/PSM to deployable application artifacts
- [judo-tatami-base](../../runtime/judo-tatami-base): PSM transformation pipeline — models to schemas, expressions, and configurations
- [judo-tatami-client](../../runtime/judo-tatami-client): ESM-to-UI model transformation using Eclipse Epsilon ETL
- [judo-tatami-jsl](../../runtime/judo-tatami-jsl): JSL-to-runtime model transformation engine (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, etc.)
- [judo-tatami-jsl-tests](../../runtime/judo-tatami-jsl-tests): Full-stack test application generation from JSL model definitions
- [judo-tatami-tests](../../runtime/judo-tatami-tests): Integration test suite demonstrating platform capabilities
- [judo-tatami-util](../../runtime/judo-tatami-util): Utility facade for EMF model transformation traces
- [judo-jsl-springboot-parent](../../spring/judo-jsl-springboot-parent): Parent POM for JUDO JSL Spring Boot applications
- [epsilon-maven-plugin](../epsilon-maven-plugin): Maven plugin for Epsilon model transformation scripts
- [judo-esm-schema-merge-maven-plugin](../judo-esm-schema-merge-maven-plugin): Maven plugin merging ESM entity definitions across split schemas
